name: Tiny City
tagline: zone it, grow it, keep them happy

help.goal: Grow a town on a small plot. Mayor mode asks for 2000 people within 20 years; Sandbox just builds.
steps: Pick a build chip, then tap a tile to place it.
Lay roads first, because every building must touch one.
Add a ⚡ plant so your buildings have power.
Tap ▶ Next year to collect taxes and let people move in.
Pick 🚜 to bulldoze, or tap ↻ twice for a new city.
notes: A ⚠ on a tile means it has no road or no power.
Blocks packed side by side grow taller and hold far more people.
Sandbox never ends and cannot be lost; Mayor runs out of years.
